entities.name: Felothar Zanhar
entities.description: Human warrior of Tarkir, head of House Zanhar and khan of the Abzan Houses, bound to the spirit dragon Betor.

entities.name: Betor
entities.description: Spirit dragon called into being by Felothar during the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: Dragon who ruled Felothar's clan, stripped her of rank and ordered her execution; later overthrown.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Spirit communed with by Felothar at a sunken Kin-Tree.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: Last Abzan khan before the Khanfall, an ancestral tie of Felothar.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Jeskai Waymaster rescued by the Abzan.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker whose wild dragons besieged Narset and Elspeth.

entities.name: Abzan Houses
entities.description: Tarkir clan ruled by the khan Felothar Zanhar.

entities.name: Council of Houses
entities.description: Council of house representatives that advises Felothar and chose her as khan.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual during which Felothar called Betor into being.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Felothar called on the spirits.

events.summary: Felothar, separated from her sunken unit, communes with the spirit of Anafenza at a Kin-Tree.
events.quote: She came across a sunken Kin-Tree and communed with the spirit of Anafenza .

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Felothar calls on the spirits to save allies; Dromoka strips her of rank and orders her execution.
events.quote: so the dragon stripped Felothar of her rank and ordered her execution

events.summary: Felothar flees beneath the Wastes and rises to lead the Abzan rebellion.
events.quote: eventually rising to leadership in the rebellion

events.summary: Felothar calls the spirit dragon Betor into being during the Stormnexus Ritual.
events.quote: Felothar called the spirit dragon Betor into being

events.summary: After Dromoka is overthrown, Felothar reinstitutes House Zanhar and is chosen khan of the Abzan.
events.quote: was chosen as the new khan of the Abzan by the Council of Houses

events.summary: Felothar and the Abzan rescue Narset and Elspeth Tirel from Sarkhan's wild dragons.
events.quote: Felothar and the Abzan came to the rescue.

relations.quote: the current khan of the Abzan Houses
so the dragon stripped Felothar of her rank and ordered her execution

relations.note: Bound to the spirit dragon she called into being.
relations.quote: bound to the spirit dragon Betor
